integrity: The displayed formulas follow from a full heat-kernel Laplacian computation and strict sign inequalities for every dimension; exact-rational independent grounded-Laplacian checks were performed. Originality assessment is non-exhaustive and no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
limitations: Canonical Euclidean-orthogonal cut and cycle projections only, on simple real unweighted cones over binary cubes. No assertion about best nonorthogonal projections, weighted edges, or intermediate induced exponents. Finite exact checks corroborate but do not prove all-dimensional formulas.
title: A dimension-five edge-orbit transition for cut–cycle norms on coned hypercubes
